■ Stage Direction
Trailing tone: Image of groaning
...Are you thinking that I'm as stubborn as ever?

I believe that a Trainer should possess something
an Umamusume could never create on her own.

...I heard rumors that you've been rejecting countless scouting offers on the spot.
Even after repeated warnings from the instructors, nothing has changed.

I understand full well that this sort of advice is exceedingly bothersome to you.
However, in my position, I must speak up.

Without an assigned Trainer, you cannot make your debut.
...If this continues, it may be deemed a refusal to race, potentially leading to expulsion.
...Listen, why can't you just do what the teacher says?

I just can't bring myself to fulfill what they desire.
I wouldn't be able to walk that path alongside them.

...Right after that, I joined a club team, didn't I?
I was so eager back then. ...Though in the end, it didn't work out.
*cough*...—

(I can always remember it so vividly. The moment that narrow gate flew open,
and the lush green turf welcomed every single part of me.)

I just can't understand the point of chasing glory.
Neither 'GⅠ victories' nor the legend of the 'Triple Crown.'
(I thought I had found the freest place in the whole world.)
...Why is it that everyone else can run for the sake of something?

(Skipping school, not knowing what I was supposed to do...
Then one day—)

(I got scolded for wearing gym clothes to school because uniforms felt too stifling.
And when the blue sky felt so nice that I ditched class for a walk, I got scolded again.)

...Seeing an Umamusume with a future as promising as yours remain stalled
is concerning to me personally as well. At the very least, I want to know the reason.

...... It's not like I don't want a contract, honestly.
I just haven't found anyone who clicks with me.

...Tracen Academy, the stage for the highest caliber of racing.
I thought I might find a way to run freely here, but...
So, what did you want to talk about?
No, I suppose that is just like you.

......
You're being pretty boring today, Rudolf.
The reason, huh...

...Why not try shifting your perspective, C.B.?
Values... need not align as rigidly as you think.

(The schoolyard in the pouring rain looked so shiny.
It was so much fun that I ran around completely absorbed in it, and got scolded for that, too.)

Forcing someone to conform to my way of doing things wouldn't be right either.
So it's just a vicious cycle.

...Huh? You're short a runner, so you want me to fill in?
I... I've never been in a race before, though... Are you sure?

(Even when told to look right, I couldn't do it unless it made sense to me.
The values that felt completely natural to me easily made enemies.)

After finishing some shopping in town,
I hurried on my way back since it had gotten quite late, when—
*pant*, *gasp*... *whew*... *huff*...
(Ever since I was little, I never really fit in with those around me.)

(......
...Why can't I just run in races on my own?)
Ugh...
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...
——...Phew!

Huh, these gates are actually pretty tight!
So once this opens, we start—
